text:
Dmitri: Heads-up — we're seeing ~150 GPU pods stuck in Pending in ap-southeast1 after last night's prebind rollout. Many are pending on attach/taint handoff and not making progress.
Infra-bot: alert: 150 pods pending in cluster gpu-prod-ap-southeast1 — https://console/reports/alerts/1739912345
Alice: Ugh, saw eviction churn earlier this morning. Is this the prebind-window tweak we rolled?
Ben: Yep, I flipped prebind-window=8s to cut latebinds on heavy workloads. Suspicion: interacts badly with taint-propagation/conntrack delays in that region.
Carla: Can we hotfix by disabling prebind or widening window? We need a quick mitigation to stop churn.
Dmitri: Ops-SRE — can you do an emergency canary rollback for ap-southeast1? Prefer minimal blast radius (a/b/c).
Ops-SRE: on it. Starting canary rollback for ap-southeast1a/b/c now. ETA ~6m. I'll post progress.
Ben: Posting a few lines from the scheduler logs that look relevant:
```
I0325 10:12:34 scheduler.go:prebind latch sleep=1200ms pod=ml-train-abc node=gpux-apse1c-07
I0325 10:12:36 attach: conntrack timeout attaching vol pvc-ml-01
I0325 10:12:39 prebind: waiting for taint-propagation node=gpux-apse1c-09 duration=7.9s
```
Carla: Also seeing NV attach/concurrency backlog on kubelet side — suggest bump attach-concurrency from 3 -> 10 temporarily. That reduces timeouts for ephemeral GPU mounts.
Dmitri: I'll roll the attach-concurrency bump in ap-southeast1 after rollback completes.
Infra-bot: deploybot: rollback triggered by Ops-SRE at 1739912400, rolling out to ap-southeast1a,b,c.
Alice: Early signal — pending count dropped from 150 -> 60 in first 90s post-rollback. Seems like prebind was amplifying the taint wait.
Ops-SRE: rollback finished for a/b/c at 1739912480. Continuing to monitor.
Dmitri: Now applying attach-concurrency bump (daemonset patch) in a small canary (10% nodes) before full rollout.
Ben: After both actions, pending fell to ~22 in 4m, eviction churn subsided. Good immediate outcome.
Carla: We should still follow up: prebind-window heuristics must consider taint propagation and conntrack metrics per-region. Creating a ticket.
Dmitri: Agreed. Filing an RFC + postmortem stub now. RFC: https://go/repo/rfcs/prebind-latch (draft)
Ben: Long-term ideas: tie prebind-window to 95th taint-prop latency, or detect nvlink/attach backpressure and fallback to latebind.
Alice: Also recommend adding a region-specific safety guard in scheduler rollout (feature-flag targeting), so apac regions can be excluded from aggressive prebind until telemetry is green.
Dmitri: I'll author the postmortem once stable — include metrics (pending counts, attach time, prebind wait) and a cost estimate for the churn. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Infra-bot: incident: monitor status updated to "mitigated" at 1739912595. Keep an eye on the dashboard: https://console/infra/metrics/gpu-pending/ap-southeast1
Carla: copying ops-runbook notes into ticket.
Dmitri: closing thread for now, will reopen if counts spike again.
